title: Live Capture Snapshot Integration & Safe Activation Readiness

root_cause_analysis.issue: Market Intelligence staging UI falls back to canonical frozen baseline instead of real live BTCUSDT spot prices.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_1: Server Live Capture container image (cbe-080-shadow:coolify-live-capture) was built in Sprint 09.14 (commit 78096f6, Oct 10), predating the factual snapshot publishing architecture.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_2: Live Capture container was Exited (0) due to restart: 'no' policy, leaving 1875 historical raw candles without live_market_state.json.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_3: FactualMarketDataAdapter requires writer_heartbeat_utc <= 120s; without periodic heartbeat refresh between 5m candle closures, snapshots would enter boundary staleness.

changes: Enhanced publish_factual_snapshot() to strictly require is_closed=True, validate candle age (<= 1800s for LIVE_OBSERVED), compute 24h price change percentage from rolling buffer (>= 288 bars), and write atomically to both snapshot_dir/btcusdt_factual_latest.json and shadow_data_dir/live_market_state.json.
Added update_writer_heartbeat() to periodically refresh writer heartbeat timestamp without mutating immutable candle data.
Added 30-second periodic heartbeat loop in LiveCaptureService.run(), ensuring writer_heartbeat_utc remains fresh (< 120s) between 5-minute candle completions.
Aligned named volume to ${CBE_CAPTURE_VOLUME_NAME:-zgit1s3n1acdtqtsxp0s44vj_cbe-080-live-capture-data} matching staging compose.

20 comprehensive automated tests covering snapshot generation, closed-candle gate, malformed payload rejection, atomic writes, age demotion, heartbeat demotion, periodic heartbeats, missing fallback, schema validation, 24h price calculation, startup replay, ledger immutability, volume parity, freeze 29/29, APPROVAL4=False, trading=False, prospective scoring=False, service preflight, and HTTP routing.

runtime_integration_points.closed_candle_event: MarketCaptureEngineV080.process_raw_message() persists to raw JSONL and SQLite index, verifies candle.is_closed is True, then executes publish_factual_snapshot().
runtime_integration_points.startup_replay: MarketCaptureEngineV080.__init__() reconstructs rolling buffer from existing raw candles and immediately publishes factual snapshot, ensuring immediate availability on restart.
runtime_integration_points.periodic_heartbeat: LiveCaptureService.run() calls engine.update_writer_heartbeat() every 30 seconds during idle waiting periods.

volume_topology.ledger_protection: Staging web service has strictly read-only access; raw evidence SQLite and JSONL files cannot be written or modified by reader.
